summary: A tower list revised in February 2016 and an undated Topo Zone list name a Quincy Lookout Tower in Gadsden County; no build date, design or current site status found.

evidence.supports: Page for a Quincy lookout gives the county as Gadsden
Florida tower list was revised in February 2016
Tower list names a Quincy Lookout Tower in Gadsden County
Topo Zone list of Gadsden County towers uses the same name

sources.title: Map of Towers in Gadsden County, Florida

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a stub page with the name and county only, plus two list entries (one revised February 2016, one undated). The 2016 list point (30.60333, -84.65306) is about 16 m from the record point (30.60327, -84.65291), so the record location holds. No source gives a build date, design, height, staffing or fate. The Florida Division of Forestry booklet on Scribd has an undated District 2 report that covers Gadsden County (seven steel lookout towers serving private landowners, four more planned), but it does not name Quincy, so it was not used. Story is under the 120-word floor and was kept short rather than padded. The Anyplace America topo page for this tower returned 403 and was not read. Record status unknown; no correction proposed.
